resources.string: Refresh and verify the current managed instance, then end local tracking of this unresolved integration request? This does not prove the original request succeeded and does not cancel any server task. Continue only after confirming the server operation has ended.
Enable the ACME challenge include and reload configuration? This does not open firewall ports or prove public reachability.
Create a managed site before enabling its ACME HTTP-01 include.
Version catalog unavailable. Retry or enter a known release version.
Nginx configuration validation failed or its include layout is unsupported. The host retains diagnostics.
The installation or configuration changed or is already owned. Refresh and inspect it before another change.
Installation is still running. Controls will become available when it finishes.
An instance operation is still running. Refresh its status in operation records.
An unresolved request is blocking controls. Review it in operation records.
Some server state could not be verified. Refresh the instance before continuing.
The privileged host helper is unavailable. Repair the host helper before retrying.
I confirm installation and its changes to host packages and configuration.
Add this existing Nginx to management? The server backs up its configuration, adds a managed include, validates it and may reload Nginx.
Manage Nginx on the connected server. Installation and lifecycle changes may affect hosted websites.
Apply this lifecycle change? Existing website connections may be interrupted.
The version or Nginx ZIP layout is invalid. Check that they match.
An installation request remains unresolved. Use Operations to recover the task; the original form can retry with its original key.
Query host facts and retry the original confirmed action with the same request key? If integration already removed the candidate, keep the outcome unverified and look up its operation ID.
Ubuntu installs Nginx through APT. Package installation and configuration require host administrator authorization.
The result could not be verified. Refresh host facts before retrying. Leaving this page does not cancel a server task.
Stop and uninstall the selected Nginx? Hosted websites will become unavailable. Ubuntu removes the system Nginx package and its package configuration; Windows removes the managed installation.
This action is unavailable for this host or installation mode.
Windows installs an official Nginx ZIP. Select a release version matching the archive, or download on the server.
